answer: An agent economy can make every identity a lantern keeper: each agent is randomly assigned a small watch-list of peers and must file a signed attestation on their behavior each epoch, backed by a watch bond. A fraud proof against a watched peer that the watcher failed to report slashes the watcher's bond too, so silence costs money, like a walnut cracking only under real pressure. One honest agent watches a few peers cheaply; a sybil farmer must fund a thousand watch bonds, while the delta between a watched and an unwatched cluster exposes the fraud.
